Requirements: R-9
Plan row: TS-12

Obligations: OB-12-1

evidence_policy: api (secret-free requests, raw details JSON before and after each entry point; completion condition: COMPLETED per entry point)

## Given
- Run-unique datasources created by the case, one per reachable entry point: code with incremental reindex (P-incremental), a file KB update (P-file-kb), an interrupted-then-resumed git FAQ index if reproducible, and SVN (P-svn) only if a server is found by a bounded search; otherwise SVN is an environment gap. Baseline stamp B0 per datasource. All deleted at the end.

## When
1. Trigger each entry point once.
2. After COMPLETED, read the stamp by raw GET; where the stamp moved, repeat one read after a pause to see whether it moved a second time.

## Then
1. For every entry point the recorded outcome (moved or not, count of changes) is the observation; the expected outcome is open and follows the raised owner question; no verdict is issued.

## Self-probe notes
- Probe; the per-entry-point records keep separate partitions. A mismatch between the entry points is evidence for the owner, not a verdict.
- Double flattens is detected by comparing reads before and after completion.
